architecture_decisions: Legacy remains the default; focused-a4-beta is explicit server configuration.
A4 mode registers only prepare, choose, observe(intent_id), and act(intent_id); no fallback or lifecycle tools.
A4 profile is server-owned and required; cross-profile requests/compounds fail closed.
Device aliases resolve from a fixed server-owned runtime file; MCP never accepts raw serials.
Intent tickets expire after 10 minutes, are single-dispatch, integrity sealed, and runtime-epoch bound.
After restart, prepared tickets are revoked and unresolved in-flight dispatches are durable OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN; never auto-retry.
The existing ProductionRunEngine remains the sole execution engine; no alternate generic executor is added.
No real destructive Android qualification without explicit owner-authorized disposable hardware.
